tag.description: Optional, unique identifier that can be used instead of the UUID in channel operations

type.description: Type of import channel, only bulk XML, 'XML', supported.

enabled.description: Set to true to indicate that the channel should be deployed for use.

commissioned.description: Indicates if the channel is actually deployed.

listening.description: Set to true to make an enabled channel actively listen for source files to process.

transformationId.description: UUID referencing the transformation pipeline to use.

harvestUrl.description: Optional URL used to identify the channel's harvest source.

lastHarvested.description: Optional timestamp of the channel's most recent harvest.

queuedFiles.description: Count of source files in the queue. A count of -1 means there is currently no queue in the file system.

fileInProcess.description: Name of most recent file to be put in process and yet to be completed.

metadata.description: For tagging records with current time and user ID on create or update.

createdDate.description: Time stamp for the records creation.

createdByUserId.description: ID of the user creating the record.

updatedDate.description: Time stamp for the most recent update of the record.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who most recently updated the record.
